description:
Start native profiling. Instruments records CPU, hangs, and leaks on iOS. Perfetto records CPU, jank, and memory growth on Android.
Start the target app first for an attach recording. Wait for this call to return before reproducing the scenario, then call native-profiler-stop while the app is still running.
On iOS and Android, a warning names apps whose timings may be affected by native network capture (started by network-capture-start).

app_process.description: iOS: the CFBundleExecutable or display name of the app to profile. Android: the app's package name. If omitted, auto-detects the foreground app; set it only if auto-detection picks the wrong app.

device_id.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID or Android serial).

malloc_stack_logging.description: iOS only. Enable allocation stacks from app launch. Restarts the app, clears its current state, and adds CPU and memory overhead. Leave it off for CPU and hang timing. On iOS, attach recordings typically lack allocation stacks. The all-processes capture (including ARGENT_IOS_CAPTURE=all-processes) rejects this option and records no leaks.

template_path.description: iOS only. Path to an Instruments .tracetemplate file, or the name of a built-in template such as "Time Profiler" (defaults to the bundled Argent template).

name: native-profiler-start
